## This file is not designed for knitting

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```



```{r data cleaning, include=FALSE}
# Preserve IDs as text to avoid rounding large identification numbers.
airbnb_raw <- read_csv(
  "listings.csv",
  na = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
  col_types = cols(
    id = col_character(),
    host_id = col_character(),
    price = col_character(),
    host_is_superhost = col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Confirm that each listing appears once.
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(airbnb_raw$id),
  anyDuplicated(airbnb_raw$id) == 0L
)

# Select the response, ten predictors, and IDs for later checks.
airbnb_selected <- airbnb_raw %>%
  transmute(
    listing_id = id,
    host_id = host_id,

    # Response: advertised nightly price in CAD.
    price = parse_number(price),

    # Numerical predictors.
    bedrooms = bedrooms,
    beds = beds,
    review_rating = review_scores_rating,
    guest_capacity = accommodates,
    host_listings = host_listings_count,
    number_of_reviews = number_of_reviews,
    minimum_nights = minimum_nights,

    # Categorical predictors.
    superhost = factor(
      host_is_superhost,
      levels = c("f", "t"),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),
    room_type = relevel(
      factor(room_type),
      ref = "Entire home/apt"
    ),
    neighbourhood = factor(neighbourhood_cleansed)
  )

# Define model variables explicitly: IDs are not predictors.
predictors <- c(
  "bedrooms",
  "beds",
  "superhost",
  "review_rating",
  "guest_capacity",
  "host_listings",
  "room_type",
  "number_of_reviews",
  "minimum_nights",
  "neighbourhood"
)

model_variables <- c("price", predictors)

# Record missingness BEFORE excluding incomplete observations.
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  variable = model_variables,
  missing_n = vapply(
    airbnb_selected[model_variables],
    function(x) sum(is.na(x)),
    integer(1)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_percent = round(
      100 * missing_n / nrow(airbnb_selected), 1
    )
  )

# Check for an observed, finite, positive nightly price.
airbnb_priced <- airbnb_selected %>%
  filter(is.finite(price), price > 0)

# Use a consistent complete-case sample for the preliminary model.
airbnb_clean <- airbnb_priced %>%
  drop_na(all_of(model_variables)) %>%
  droplevels()

# Record how the analysis sample was obtained.
cleaning_summary <- data.frame(
  stage = c(
    "Original listings",
    "Observed positive price",
    "Complete data for all model variables"
  ),
  listings = c(
    nrow(airbnb_raw),
    nrow(airbnb_priced),
    nrow(airbnb_clean)
  )
)

# Verify the project sample-size requirement and numerical validity.
stopifnot(
  nrow(airbnb_clean) >= 1000,
  !anyNA(airbnb_clean[model_variables]),
  all(vapply(
    select(airbnb_clean, where(is.numeric)),
    function(x) all(is.finite(x)),
    logical(1)
  ))
)
```



```{r check cleaning, include=FALSE}
cleaning_summary
missing_summary

summary(airbnb_clean[model_variables])

table(airbnb_clean$room_type)
table(airbnb_clean$superhost)

# Examine whether hosts contribute multiple listings.
airbnb_clean %>%
  count(host_id, name = "listings_in_analysis") %>%
  summarise(
    unique_hosts = n(),
    hosts_with_multiple_listings = sum(listings_in_analysis > 1),
    largest_host_group = max(listings_in_analysis)
  )
```



```{r save cleaned data, include=FALSE}
readr::write_csv(airbnb_clean, "airbnb_clean.csv")
```



```{r fit preliminary model, include=FALSE}
preliminary_model <- lm(
  price ~ bedrooms +
    beds +
    review_rating +
    guest_capacity +
    host_listings +
    number_of_reviews +
    minimum_nights +
    neighbourhood +
    superhost * room_type,
  data = airbnb_clean,
  na.action = na.fail
)
```



```{r preliminary model, include=FALSE}
# Coefficients, standard errors, t-tests, and model fit.
summary(preliminary_model)

# 95% confidence intervals for regression coefficients.
confint(preliminary_model)

# Number of observations used.
nobs(preliminary_model)

# Store estimates and uncertainty for a formatted results table.
coefficient_summary <- coef(summary(preliminary_model))
coefficient_ci <- confint(preliminary_model)

model_results <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(coefficient_summary),
  estimate = coefficient_summary[, "Estimate"],
  standard_error = coefficient_summary[, "Std. Error"],
  conf_low = coefficient_ci[rownames(coefficient_summary), 1],
  conf_high = coefficient_ci[rownames(coefficient_summary), 2],
  p_value = coefficient_summary[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
  row.names = NULL
)
```



```{r model results table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(kableExtra)

# Create a display table without changing model_results.
results_table <- model_results %>%
  filter(!grepl("^neighbourhood", term)) %>%
  transmute(
    Term = term,
    Estimate = estimate,
    SE = standard_error,
    `95% CI` = sprintf("(%.2f, %.2f)", conf_low, conf_high),
    `p-value` = format.pval(p_value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
  )

knitr::kable(
  results_table,
  format = "pipe",
  digits = 2,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = paste(
    "Preliminary regression of nightly price (CAD).",
    "Neighbourhood coefficients are included in the model but not shown."
  )
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "repeat_header",
    font_size = 8,
    full_width = FALSE
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "5cm")
```



```{r main-diagnostics, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=3.5, out.width="100%", fig.align="center", fig.cap="Preliminary model diagnostics: residuals versus fitted values, normal Q-Q plot of residuals, and observed price versus fitted values."}
# Extract values from the fitted model.
e <- resid(preliminary_model)
y_hat <- fitted(preliminary_model)
y <- model.response(model.frame(preliminary_model))

# Save graphics settings and create a 1-by-3 grid.
old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(
  mfrow = c(1, 3),
  mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1),
  cex = 0.85
)

point_colour <- adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.25)

# 1. Residuals versus fitted values.
plot(
  y_hat, e,
  main = "Residuals vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted price (CAD)",
  ylab = "Residuals (CAD)",
  pch = 16, cex = 0.4, col = point_colour
)
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

# 2. Normal Q-Q plot of residuals.
qqnorm(
  e,
  main = "Normal Q-Q Plot",
  xlab = "Theoretical quantiles",
  ylab = "Sample residual quantiles",
  pch = 16, cex = 0.4, col = point_colour
)
qqline(e, col = "red", lty = 2)

# 3. Observed response versus fitted values.
plot(
  y_hat, y,
  main = "Price vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted price (CAD)",
  ylab = "Observed price (CAD)",
  pch = 16, cex = 0.4, col = point_colour
)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, col = "red", lty = 2)

# Restore graphics settings.
par(old_par)
```
